edits.old: round(case when in_marketo=1 then marketo_engagement else 0 end + case when in_stripe=1 then stripe_engagement else 0 end + case when in_zendesk=1 then zendesk_engagement else 0 end,2) as cross_platform_consistency

edits.old:
case when marketing_engagement_score>=sales_engagement_score and marketing_engagement_score>=support_engagement_score then 'Marketing Driven'
 when sales_engagement_score>=support_engagement_score then 'Sales Driven' when support_engagement_score is not null then 'Support Driven' else 'Balanced' end as primary_engagement_channel
edits.new: CASE WHEN marketo_engagement >= stripe_engagement AND marketo_engagement >= zendesk_engagement THEN 'Marketing Driven' WHEN stripe_engagement >= marketo_engagement AND stripe_engagement >= zendesk_engagement THEN 'Sales Driven' WHEN zendesk_engagement >= marketo_engagement AND zendesk_engagement >= stripe_engagement THEN 'Support Driven' ELSE 'Balanced' END AS primary_engagement_channel
